decisions.reason: The lump sum covers temporary site setup and mobilization, not the purchase of a new product.
This is a temporary detour traffic-control service. The materials remain the contractor’s property.
The ordered volume covers trench excavation and reuse of excavated material. Forming the trench bottom does not supply a new product.
The work reinstalls and compacts excavated gravel already stockpiled beside the trench.
This position places, grades, and compacts soil processed under the preceding position; it does not supply new soil.
This position covers handling, transport, and landfill disposal of existing excavated soil, including placement or compaction if required.
The ordered hours cover temporary pump use and operation for dewatering, not purchase of the pump.
Dewatering is ordered by the day, and the sump pipe is temporarily installed, then withdrawn and hauled away.
The existing delineator posts are removed, stored on site, and reinstalled.
The existing signs and posts are removed, stored, and reinstalled in their original locations.
Position 2.5.30 orders dump-truck hours. The pipe supply wording appears in subsequent section headings, not in the ordered line.
The position covers collecting and returning existing packaging and pipe end caps to the supplier.
The surcharge covers tying new pipe into the existing network, including shutdown and restart. Required fittings are paid for separately.
The ordered work is core drilling in an existing structure. Coating touch-ups are incidental, and no new conduits or cables are supplied.
Previously excavated soil is transported and reused as backfill; no new fill is supplied.
This position covers handling, transport, and landfill disposal of existing excavated soil, including placement or compaction if required.
The price covers temporary excavation shoring, including mobilization, use, wear, and demobilization, not permanent supply of sheet piles.
